name: New York Medicare Savings Program (QMB / QI)
agency: New York State Department of Health (NYSDOH)
summary_plain: New York State pays your monthly Medicare Part B premium ($185.00/month or more), putting over $2,220 a year back into your Social Security check.

incomeRule.notes: NY expanded MSP up to ~300% FPL in 2023 for QI and 138% for QMB. No asset test in New York.

otherConditions: Must be enrolled or eligible for Medicare Part A
Must reside in New York State
No resource/asset test required in New York

benefit.description: Pays the Medicare Part B monthly premium ($185.00/mo) and for QMB pays Part A/B deductibles and coinsurance.

steps: Download the 1-page MSP application (DOH-4328) from NYSDOH or your local Dept of Social Services.
Include proof of income and a copy of your red, white, and blue Medicare card.
Mail or drop off at your local Department of Social Services (HRA in NYC).

deadlines.title: Year-round enrollment
deadlines.description: You can apply for the Medicare Savings Program at any time of year without waiting for open enrollment.

sources.title: Medicare Rights Center NY MSP Expansion Summary

name: Medicare Part D Extra Help (Low-Income Subsidy)
summary_plain: Helps pay for your Medicare prescription drug plan premiums, deductibles, and caps covered prescription copays at $4.90 for generics and $12.15 for brand names.

incomeRule.notes: Up to 150% FPL under Inflation Reduction Act full Extra Help expansion.

eligibility.assetRule: Resources under $17,220 for individuals or $34,440 for married couples (home, car, and personal items not counted). Note: Enrolling in NY MSP automatically qualifies you for Extra Help without an asset test!
otherConditions: Must have Medicare Part A and/or Part B
Automatic qualification if enrolled in NY Medicare Savings Program

benefit.description: Zero Part D plan premium for benchmark plans, zero deductible, and low copays for all formulary medications.

steps: Apply online in 15 minutes at ssa.gov/extrahelp.
Or call SSA at 1-800-772-1213 (TTY 1-800-325-0778) to request a paper form SSA-1020.
Tip: If you apply for NY MSP, Social Security will automatically enroll you in Extra Help!

deadlines.title: Continuous Enrollment
deadlines.description: Apply anytime. Extra Help also grants a Special Enrollment Period to switch drug plans once per calendar quarter.

name: NY Elderly Pharmaceutical Insurance Coverage (EPIC)
agency: New York State Department of Health
summary_plain: A New York State program for seniors aged 65 and older that helps pay Medicare Part D drug plan premiums and supplements your prescription drug coverage.

incomeRule.notes: Annual income limit up to $75,000 for singles and $100,000 for married couples.

otherConditions: Must be a New York State resident
Must be enrolled in a Medicare Part D plan or eligible to enroll
Cannot be receiving full Medicaid benefits with no spenddown

benefit.description: Pays up to the basic Part D drug premium and lowers copayments for prescription medicines at NY pharmacies.

steps: Provide proof of age (65+), NY residency, and copy of Part D card.
Call the EPIC Helpline at 1-800-332-3742 for assistance.

deadlines.title: Year-Round
deadlines.description: Enrollment is open year-round for eligible New York seniors.

name: New York SNAP (Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program / EBT)
agency: NY Office of Temporary and Disability Assistance (OTDA)
summary_plain: Provides an Electronic Benefit Transfer (EBT) card loaded with monthly grocery money to spend at supermarkets, farmers markets, and grocery stores across New York.

incomeRule.notes: New York uses Broad-Based Categorical Eligibility: households with an elderly (60+) or disabled member qualify up to 200% FPL with no asset test.

otherConditions: U.S. citizen or qualified legal resident
No asset test in NY for most households under BBCE

benefit.description: Monthly grocery benefit loaded directly onto an NY EBT card. Average senior benefit in NY is $180-$240/mo.

steps: Apply online at myBenefits.ny.gov or via Access HRA (in NYC).
Or mail an application to your local Department of Social Services.
Complete a short telephone interview with a caseworker.

deadlines.title: Rolling 30-day processing
deadlines.description: Benefits are granted within 30 days of application, or within 5 days if eligible for expedited food relief.

name: NY Essential Plan / Medicaid (NY State of Health)
summary_plain: Comprehensive health insurance with $0 monthly premium, $0 deductible, and very low copays for low- and moderate-income New Yorkers under age 65.

incomeRule.notes: Essential Plan expanded in New York up to 250% FPL under 1332 State Innovation Waiver ($0 monthly premium).

otherConditions: Not eligible for Medicare or affordable employer-sponsored coverage

benefit.description: Comprehensive medical, prescription, vision, and dental coverage with $0 monthly premium and $0 deductible.

steps: Work with a free local Certified Navigator or enrollment counselor.
Select an Essential Plan carrier serving your county.

deadlines.title: Open All Year
deadlines.description: Enrollment in the Essential Plan and Medicaid is open all year round in New York.

sources.title: NY State of Health Essential Plan Expansion

name: New York Home Energy Assistance Program (HEAP)
agency: NY Office of Temporary and Disability Assistance (OTDA)
summary_plain: Grants to help low- and moderate-income New York households pay for heating fuel, electricity bills, cooling equipment in summer, and furnace repairs.

incomeRule.notes: Based on NY State Median Income (up to ~60% of State Median Income).

otherConditions: Either pay directly for heating fuel or pay for heating in rent
Automatic eligibility if household receives SNAP, Temporary Assistance, or SSI

benefit.description: One-time seasonal heating or cooling benefit (ranging from $400 to $900+ paid directly to utility or heating vendor).

steps: Apply online at myBenefits.ny.gov or through your county Department of Social Services.
If 60 or older, you can apply through your local NY Office for the Aging.
Submit heating fuel bill and recent income verification.

deadlines.title: Seasonal Heating Window
deadlines.description: Regular HEAP opens in November each winter and remains open until funding closes in spring.
